name: BOOKED.
description: AI readability infrastructure for fashion creatives. BOOKED. closes the legibility gap between career quality and digital discoverability — so casting directors, agents, and AI systems find the right people.
slogan: Your work is good. The infrastructure around it isn't.

entryPoint.description: Free AI readability scan — entry point for all BOOKED. services

itemListElement.name: Visibility Scan
itemListElement.description: Free directional read of a fashion creative's digital presence. Identifies likely gaps across portfolio structure, search presence, profile clarity, and booking friction before any paid work is recommended.

itemListElement.name: Landing Page Preview
itemListElement.description: Free preview of how a fashion creative's work could sit inside a cleaner professional landing page, before committing to a build.

itemListElement.name: Portfolio Audit
itemListElement.description: Scored read of the portfolio: what is working, what is costing bookings, and the order to fix it in. Each image assessed for sequence, commercial strength, category fit, repetition, visual authority, and booking readability.

itemListElement.name: AI Readability Layer
itemListElement.description: The work structured so AI search and casting tools can read it, built onto an existing site. Role clarity, page hierarchy, semantic copy, credits, captions, metadata.

itemListElement.name: Fix Sprint
itemListElement.description: One friction point, fixed and live — the single thing most costing bookings right now. Scope agreed in writing before payment.

itemListElement.name: Landing Page Build
itemListElement.description: One page: work, credits, contact — built to be found. Proper structure, image sequencing, a direct contact path, and the machine-readable layer underneath it.

itemListElement.name: Portfolio Infrastructure Build
itemListElement.description: Full portfolio site. Structure, copy, and the machine-readable layer underneath it: portfolio architecture, page structure, image sequencing, project context, credits, contact path, semantic copy.

itemListElement.name: Legacy
itemListElement.description: Complete infrastructure engagement. Scan audit, custom portfolio website, credit recovery and indexing, AI agent infrastructure, agency profile audit, and 90-day follow-up. Scope agreed in writing before payment.
